starting_state.independent_review: Sol Medium independently confirmed the 140-byte extent, full-word queue field, dispatcher entries 7–10, biased byte-table values, and the separate latch/output-byte paths.

original_mips_evidence.raw_validation: Parsed all 35 target instructions from pinned assembly comments. The exact 0x8C-byte slice matches both SHA-verified USA ROM images; raw-slice SHA-256 is recorded in source_snapshot.
original_mips_evidence.entry_and_dispatch: The 32-bit queue word is stored to D_801C0A20 before the dispatcher masks its low halfword for table selection. Table indices 7–10 at ROM 0x6F1E8..0x6F1F4 all target 0x8003A138. The direct caller at 0x80039008 stores mode 10 in the jal delay slot. The target itself reloads the full word with lw.
original_mips_evidence.lookup: The target adds the full D_801C0A20 word to byte-table label D_8006E601_6F201, with no mask or bounds check. The label is seven bytes before the actual four-byte table. Modes 7–10 read bytes at ROM 0x6F208..0x6F20B with values 1, 2, 8, 8. The instructions do not distinguish signed from unsigned C declarations for the word.
branch_matrix: Mode != 10 reads D_801C09D3 with lbu; zero writes byte 0xFF. It then reads the indexed table byte and stores it to D_801C09D1 and D_801C09D2; the D2 byte store occupies the jr delay slot.
Mode == 10 reads D_801C09D6 with lbu; zero writes byte 0xFF. It then reads the same full-word-indexed table and stores the byte to D_801C09D4 and D_801C09D5 before jr.
Nonzero latch bytes are preserved. The target has no stack frame or calls and does not touch D7, the D8 halfword, DA, DB, or DC.
original_mips_evidence.neighbor_contract: The matched 8003A1C4 helper reads D8 as an unsigned halfword and conditionally writes byte DA; matched 8003A204/8003A228 read byte DC and conditionally write byte DB; 8003A1E8 clears halfword D8 and byte DA. These widths and addresses remain separate from G64-067's D1–D6 byte accesses.
unknown: The semantic names of D3 and D6 latches are not established.
Beyond the demonstrated dispatcher modes 7–10, the range and producers of D_801C0A20 are not established; the target has no range check.
No in-game capture links these state writes to an observed user-visible action.

first_mismatch.classification: Branch-layout and delay-slot scheduling. IDO moves the mode-10 D6 latch-address calculation into the branch delay slot, then calculates the D3 address in the fallthrough body; the original delay slot calculates D3. The target remains 140 bytes, but 28 of 35 instruction words differ.
